tagline: A leader in high-end beer, wine and spirits with iconic brands and global reach
hero_kpi_rationale: Long-term debt of $10,361.2 million represents significant financial leverage that impacts Constellation's capital strategy and operational flexibility, particularly amid commercial challenges in the Wine and Spirits segment.

kpis.name: Goodwill Impairment
kpis.explanation: Goodwill impairment due to declining values of wine and spirits brands following downturns in the U.S. wholesale market
kpis.description: Preliminary quantitative assessment as of August 31, 2024, and annual assessment for fiscal 2025, resulting in a total goodwill impairment loss of $2,740.7 million in the Wine and Spirits segment, driven by negative trends in the U.S. wholesale market and weakening mainstream and premium wine brands
kpis.signal: Significant goodwill impairment with carrying value reduced to zero

kpis.name: Wine Brands Impairment
kpis.explanation: Impairment of wine and spirits trademarks due to depressed market conditions
kpis.description: Quantitative assessment of wine trademarks resulting in a $57.0 million impairment on certain wine brands held for sale, driven by the same negative trends in the U.S. wholesale market
kpis.signal: Trademark impairments as a consequence of the same factors affecting goodwill

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2022-2026) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: High Debt
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant contractual obligations, including long-term debt of $10,361.2 million as of February 28, 2026, with interest on long-term debt totaling $3,582.1 million.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks due to its international operations and has implemented foreign currency hedging programs.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has substantial credit obligations with $10,361.2 million in long-term debt and $3,582.1 million in contractual interest payments.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations in the wine, spirits, and beer markets which may impact its operations and margins.

risks.title: Tax and Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to international tax risks and tariff changes. In February 2025, aluminum tariffs impacted fiscal 2026. In April 2026, malt-based beer was removed from Section 232 tariffs.

risks.title: Market and Consumer Demand Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces market risks due to negative trends in the U.S. wine wholesale market, declines in the overall wine market, and economic uncertainty affecting consumer discretionary spending.

risks.title: Goodwill and Intangible Assets Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded a goodwill impairment loss of $2,740.7 million in fiscal 2025 and a trademark impairment of $57.0 million due to declines in the U.S. wine wholesale market and negative trends in its mainstream and premium brands.

ai_positioning.summary: STZ does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K filing for fiscal 2026. No strategic, operational, or technological references to AI are present.
